get.summary: ListAccounts returns the list of accounts
CanI checks if the current account has permission to perform an action

put.summary: UpdatePassword updates an account's password to a new value

get.summary: GetAccount returns an account
GetNotificationStatus returns the notification service runtime status.
ListNotificationDeliveries returns notification delivery records.

post.summary: SendTestNotification sends a fixed test notification from the UI.

get.summary: GetNotificationDelivery returns one notification delivery record.
ListPolymarketHotMarkets returns discovered hot markets.
ListPolymarketMovers returns price mover market rows.
ListPolymarketRealtimeMarkets returns realtime market rows.
ListPolymarketSportsLiveMarkets returns sports live market rows.
GetPolymarketSportsLiveSnapshot returns sports live event cards.
GetPolymarketStatus returns the polymarket service runtime status.

post.summary: Create a new JWT for authentication and set a cookie if using HTTP

delete.summary: Delete an existing JWT cookie if using HTTP

get.summary: Get the current user's info
Get returns Athena settings
GetWalletStatus returns the wallet service runtime status.
ListWallets returns persisted wallet records without secret material.

post.summary: CreateWallet creates a new wallet for one chain.
ImportMnemonic imports a mnemonic-derived wallet for one chain.
ImportPrivateKey imports a private key for one chain.

get.summary: GetWallet returns one wallet record and optionally reveals secret material.

post.summary: UpdateWalletAlias updates wallet alias text without changing secret material.

GetWormMarket returns one market detail from Worm.
GetWormStatus returns the worm service runtime status.
